user.title: Connect Cookpal
user.description: Create an API key in the Cookpal app under Settings > API keys and tick at least "Read shopping lists". Tick "Add, tick off and remove items" too if Home Assistant should change the list.

data_description.url: The address of your Cookpal server. Keep the default unless you run your own.
data_description.api_key: Starts with cpk_. Cookpal shows it only once, right after creating it.

lists.title: Shopping lists
lists.description: Pick the lists to show as to-do lists. You can change this later.

reauth_confirm.title: Cookpal needs a new API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} no longer works: it was revoked, or the account can no longer sign in. Create a new key for the same account in the Cookpal app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Cookpal server at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is not valid. It may have been revoked.
error.api_keys_disabled: This Cookpal server does not accept API keys.
error.missing_scope: The API key cannot read shopping lists. Create one with "Read shopping lists" ticked.

abort.already_configured: This Cookpal account is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: This API key belongs to a different Cookpal account.

init.title: Shopping lists
init.description: Pick the lists to show as to-do lists.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cookpal to read your lists. Try again later.

auth_failed.message: Cookpal no longer accepts the API key. Set up a new one where Home Assistant asks for it.

read_only.message: The API key may only read this list.

update_failed.message: Cookpal could not save the change: {error}

list_gone.title: A Cookpal shopping list is gone
list_gone.description: A shopping list picked for {entry} was deleted, or you left the household it belonged to. Open the integration's options and pick your lists again.
